items.headline: El Salvador eliminates trachoma, the world's leading infectious cause of blindness
items.summary: The World Health Organization has formally validated El Salvador as having eliminated trachoma as a public health problem, following years of community assessments that found no active transmission of the disease. The achievement means no signs of the disease were found in children and no blinding cases were found in adults during the multi-year review.
items.why_it_matters: It marks another country crossing off a disease that has historically caused blindness and disability among the world's poorest communities, moving the region closer to eliminating trachoma across the Americas by 2030.
